dcterms:description: A dataset comprising audio-visual recordings of language productions from 10 individuals with Alzheimer's disease and 10 matched controls, analyzed for disfluencies at segmental and suprasegmental levels during repetition tasks with and without imposed gestures.
dcterms:title: Disfluencies in Alzheimer's Disease Dataset
